title: Abbas tere khoon se
body:
abbas tere khoon se rangeen hai alam tera
dil seene mein jab tak hai jayega na gham tera
<<DIVIDER>>
tooti jo kamar sheh ki bas do to sadme thay
ek fikr thi zainab ki aur doosra gham tera
abbas tere khoon se...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashk aur alam sarwar darya se utha laaye
zainab se utha hoga kis tarha se gham tera
abbas tere khoon se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay sher e jari jab tu darya ko sidhara tha
tha mashke sakina mein ya seene mein dam tera
abbas tere khoon se...
<<DIVIDER>>
behte huwe pani mein tasveer e sakina thi
dam de diya darya se utha na qadam tera
abbas tere khoon se...
author: Muntaqim Hasnain
